snippet.title: Aerosurfer Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Skies: Where Flow, Focus, and Speed Collide

Glide and surf through handcrafted tracks at breakneck speed. The closer you fly to the ground, the faster you go! Chase your best times, race against your ghost, and climb the leaderboards in a high speed journey of control and flow.

Wishlist on the Meta Quest Store: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/aerosurfer/32631602343151033/
